- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — cap 30d forecast max at 1.2x recent 7d high to prevent overshoot.
- If sentiment shifts from negative to positive within 3 days, adjust forecast downward by 2–5% to avoid lagged overcorrection.
- For 30d horizon, apply 10–15% downward bias if sentiment history shows high volatility or recent divergence (>0.25 standard deviation from mean).
- If sentiment is consistently high (>0.7) over 5+ days, reduce forecast slope to avoid overestimating continuation.
